pages: Hehe... thank you, Galford.
With this new uniform, I'm feeling pure justice!
Cough... Yes, I like it.
Hmph... it'll do.
Yay!
But Cham Cham's keeping the ears and tail Chona Chona gave her safe!
With this color...
Chona Chona's ears and tail go best, yeah!
Hmm... it's truly no worse than a Parisian tailor's work.
Their boasting was well earned.
Hey... that looks good on you, Charlotte!
Guess a beauty looks good in anything, huh?
D-don't be ridiculous...
Splendid! Just what I'd expect of Kuzuhara.
Fine tailoring as always! Bravo!
Thank you as always, Lord Kyoshiro...
We've given you the usual half-price discount.
Yay! How do I look? Does it suit me?
Hehe... oh, Rimururu... Yes, it suits you very well.
Rising white steam, a gentle bath on the road, bears off deathly fever.
Hey there, customer! Your money, your money!
...Hey, hey! You've got to pay for your bath!
We're closed for the time being!
Hehehe... well, see,
there was this huge black catfish going wild.
And after a hard-fought battle, yours truly...
Slash!
...took it down, see...
Truth is, that earthquake was the work of demons...
And this here Haohmaru...
Hmph... I care nothing for earthquakes...
I'd cut a giant catfish in two with a single stroke.
...Hmph. You know nothing, do you?
Demons had their sights set on Edo.
Heh... Earthquakes may be frightening...
but these days, women are far more so.
Just between us...
the power of the demon realm was invading Edo.
No problemo!
If you live bright and honest, earthquakes are nothing to fear!
Yes... you be careful too.
That earthquake was caused by demons.
You bet! A man born a man
can't live without his sake jug!
Sake's Haohmaru's best friend and dearest travel companion!
You bet!
...is what I'd like to say, but truth is...
No, don't ask me why.
I'm on the wagon right now!
Sake... is worthless.
Yes...
Good sake makes life richer, after all.
Forgive me...
I have a chronic illness. I can't drink much.
Of course!
Japanese people and Americans alike...
everybody loves sake!
...I'm a ninja, you know. Getting drunk is no good.
Yeah! I want to get stronger!
That's why I fight strong guys!
Win or lose, I've got no regrets!
...Maybe a woman like you
wouldn't understand, but...
...If you call yourself a swordsman, you're gonna fight.
And when you fight...
you cut, or you get cut.
Can't be helped.
Heh... anyone I don't like...
Anyone who gets in my way... I cut down.
...I am a swordsman, after all.
...One must brush off the sparks that fall on him.
Yes!
I, Galford, won't let evil get away!
It can't be helped, for the sake of justice.
I see... yeah, that's right.
My master said 'You can't know another's pain until you feel it.'
That's what he told me.
...You think so?
It doesn't really click with me.
Heh... perhaps.
Hmph... nonsense.
...Indeed.
Those who are kinder than anyone...
may be those who are hurt and struggling more than anyone...
...perhaps.
No...
In the end, others can never understand a person's suffering...
Kindness is the same. Whatever one feels inside,
it doesn't always get across.
Yes...
Being kind to others no matter how hard things are...
I think that's true strength of heart, too!
But if you smile while you're feeling sad,
only half your feelings get across.
I think it's better to live life
in a happy mood!
If someone shows you their weak side, you'd want to help 'em.
That's normal, ain't it?
I can't handle it when people cry...
I'd rather they keep on smiling.
Hmph...
Tiresome women make me want to cut them down.
...Speaking generally,
are men not drawn to
a delicate woman?
...Speaking generally,
are men not drawn to
a woman's radiant smile?
As a hero of justice, I can't ignore
a lady in tears.
I prefer a lady's smile to her tears.
Hehehe...
I'm just getting started!
Let's see... with a beauty pouring for me,
I might've had a little too much.
Hmph... I've had more than enough.
...Well... a little more, perhaps.
It seems... I've had a bit too much.
I'm not bottomless, but I'm still okay!
Phew...
Actually, I'm a no-thank-you now.
Is that so?
Then let's climb up to the top of Mount Fuji!
Fool!
Don't spout nonsense!
Hehe...
Then shall we go see the cherry blossoms at Edo Castle?
Hahaha!
Then I'll take you to my hometown!
...You think so? I'm just a swordsman.
Don't overrate me.
Hehehe... I'm kinda embarrassed.
Feels like a compliment. Tickles a bit!
Fool!
Speak such drivel again,
and I'll see your tongue never moves again!
...Is that meant as flattery?
Either way, being told such things
does not sit well with me.
...Strong eyes... you say?
No...
Just because my eyes are blue doesn't make them special.
Heh, that's the hot flame of justice burning inside me!
It ain't money I'm after.
It's... something else.
I hate getting greedy over money,
but without it, I can't drink good sake like this.
Hmph... money...
...How dull.
Heh... you're right. With money, you can buy anything.
Money is necessary, but...
there are things far more important to me.
In life, it seems one always needs money for something.
As long as gold doesn't blind you, it's fine.
Haha! With some gold,
getting to Japan would've been a lot easier!
Hah! How ridiculous!
I shall be walking about nearby. Do as you please.
Hehe... each one's as lovely as the next. Which girl strikes your fancy?
1270.question: Well... what will you do?

pages: Oh my... which girl has caught your eye?
Which girl will you spend time with?
Wha-?! But why?
...I'm sorry... no, I mean...
Please come again! Promise me!
...I see. Well then, farewell...
Huh?
Already...? Surely you can stay a little longer?
What?!
No... you must be joking!
I'll be so lonely!
What?! Oh, no!
Just when I finally... toward you...
...You're such a strong man... and I... I love strong men...
I... love... you...
I've never met a man so gentle...
Please, once more...
wrap me in your warmth...
W-well then... um...
I'll... put out the light...
W-well then... um...
I know! Let's go out and see the sights of Edo!
Let's do that!
...If it's your health, then it can't be helped...
But...
I've had... a bit too much to drink...
That's enough for today...
No... um...
...Please let me keep you company again sometime...
We're playing Cho-Han here...
1286.question: Shall I explain the rules?

pages: You roll two dice,
and guess whether the total is even (Cho) or odd (Han).
That's all there is to it.
Play two or three rounds and you'll get the hang of it.
Oh, our guest...
Hehehe, it's been a while.
This time, Cho!
Next up, Han!
Any bets on Cho? Cho!
Any bets on Han? Han!
Now then, sir... what'll it be?
Sir... could you call it a day
and let us off easy...?
Heading home?
Come play with us again sometime.
You'll win next time, sir!
I underestimated you...
Go easy on us next time.
Sir, if you'd step this way...
Our deepest apologies...
Our dice man was up to mischief.
Please accept this and forgive us.
You're causing trouble...
You're bothering the other guests!
Now get out of here!
How about it, sir?
Care to go one-on-one with me?
The bet starts at 20,
and goes up each time you win...
Will you take me on?
The bet is 20GP.
The bet is 40GP.
The bet is 80GP.
The bet is 160GP.
The bet is 320GP.
A hit! {NAME} won 20GP!
We'll start the bet at 20GP.
Dang it...!
Next bet is 40GP!
Now I'm getting serious...
Next bet is 80GP!
What's going on...? Fine, I'll win it back next time.
The bet is 160GP!
...Sir, are you a professional? This is the final match, then.
The bet is 320GP!
'A place like this,' you say? Hohoho... you fool!
This castle, now hidden underground, will soon rule over the surface!
Taking the place of Edo Castle!
What?!
So you're the ones who defeated Sankai Doushi of Fuji?
But it's too late!
The earth energy of Fuji that sustains Edo's barrier...
ran dry long ago! Thanks to the prayers of the fools! Haha!
All that's left is to wait...
for the egg of Lord Ambra to awaken!
Then this castle of darkness will rise to the surface!
Hohoho! Now! Watch as Edo falls into the demon realm
with your own eyes!
I won't let you do that!
So you mean to defy me, Ushiwaka!
Damn you, Amakusa Shiro! I'll have my son's body back!
Amakusa? Are you saying he's the ghost of Amakusa Shiro Tokisada?!
Impossible!
Oh... Lord Amakusa...
There was no need for you to come in person!
Revenge, is it? You vengeful spirit, cursing the Tokugawa!
This terrible magic power... Amakusa? Did you say Amakusa?!
Wait! You, Amakusa!
Ngh... Do not let your guard down...
The demons here are strong!
They are in a different league from the small fry around Edo!
Ngh... Master Hanzo...
Ohohohoho! How fragile!
I'd have liked to play a bit longer, but I'm a busy woman,
so I'll let you off here...
Now! Draw the dark power from the egg!
For Lord Amakusa, crush the Tokugawa's Edo Castle!
Slaughter all the fools of Edo!
Ohohohohoho!
Wait! Where are you going, Amakusa?!
Haohmaru, if you want to train, use the dojo in the back right.
Don't go practicing swings out front
and splitting another stone lantern in two!
Why not invite your fellow pupil Genjuro once in a while...
Hmph... you talk big.
Wag my tail for the likes of you? I'd sooner die!
Look at Haohmaru! This is how the weak die.
Or what?
Nicotine, is your sword meant to make losers?
Don't be foolish, Genjuro!
You haven't learned about the soul! The soul of a samurai!
Your soul is far too close to darkness!
Reconsider! Otherwise...
I'll have no choice but to expel you!
Hmph... samurai soul? Throw it to the dogs.
Better yet, drill it into Haohmaru all you like!
Genjuro! Reconsider!
Genjuroooo!
...You fool...
Edo?!
Dinner will be ready soon, so please wait a bit.
Hey... hey, Haohmaru! I'm not finished...
Honestly... that boy never learns.
A waste of time...
The priest is at the training grounds.
Hup! Then I'll take you on myself.
Let's have a match, shall we? Hohohoho!
Yes...
Lord Genjuro is... hard to approach...
He frightens me...
Lord Haohmaru is cheerful through and through, though.
Oh, that's right, Master Nicotine,
please tell Lord Haohmaru to take a bath today, for once!
Genjuro, eh...
I won't question whether cutting men down is right or wrong.
But your soul, leaning toward darkness...
Genjuro, someday it will destroy you.
Genjuro...
Your merciless strength carries the darkness of the demon realm...
I only hope you don't fall into the same trap I did.
Genjuro! Honestly... you're impossible.
You say you want to train here?
I'd rather you polished your soul than your sword.
Very well...
Show me how much you've improved!
1351.question: Will you train?

pages: I do not lie... Please turn back!
1352.question: Will you turn back?

pages: Hmm...? You don't seem to be a follower of Ambra.
Hehehehe...
Sneaking into the headquarters of the Ambra faith...
You don't know your place...
Now! Tree of evil! Finish off this Tokugawa dog!
Sankai Doushi, eh... He may be one of Amakusa's men...
Prepare yourself, Amakusa! I'll hunt you to the ends of the earth!
Hohoho, careless bunch.
Looks like you still need more training.
So this fellow has a boss somewhere.
Be on your guard. Farewell!
Hold!
A sinister power seeks to twist this land toward evil.
Here it comes!
So the road to peace is still a long one...
Farewell!
Hold it right there! What a bunch of cowards!
Gaira of Kafuin will lend you a hand!
Come on out, Sankai Doushi! I'll pound you flat!
See ya!
Kyeeeh!!
The mountain is crying! The forest is crying!
I can hear it!
Sankai Doushi... kill... I'll kill him!
Kyeeeh!
Only those who believe in Lord Ambra
may go to Lord Ambra's shrine!
By Lord Ambra's guidance, I visit the shrine...
and to be able to behold the face of Sankai Doushi...
Oh, what a blessing.
So Lord Ambra would come all the sooner,
I handed over every coin I had.
And then they let me make the pilgrimage to the Fuji shrine.
What a blessing...
Hm... are you also a follower of Ambra?
1367.question: How will you answer?

pages: O-oh, really...?! L-long live Lord Ambra!
...By the way, if you know, I'd ask you to tell me.
I hear there's a secret path to Lord Ambra's shrine...
Do you know of it?
I see... then you'd best not go any deeper.
If you're not a follower of Ambra, the demons will attack...
Me? I'm here on shogunate business...
Er, n-no, just a little errand. Hahaha...
O-oh, really...?! L-long live Lord Ambra!
...By the way, if you know, I'd ask you to tell me.
I hear there's more than one secret path to Lord Ambra's shrine...
Have you seen a samurai with two swords?
...I see...
The demons don't attack me none!
Lord Ambra's protectin' me, he is!
This is the other secret path
known only to followers of Ambra...
I am Akakuroko, the red kuroko...
For 50GP per person, I'll fully restore your HP and spirit...
1374.question: Get fully restored?

pages: Here I go...
Hyaah!
I see... but please don't push yourself too hard.
How strange...
I've searched all over and can't find the secret path...
I walked the route exactly as I was told...
Maybe I still haven't donated enough...
My hobby is traveling as a peddler... Care to buy something?
Is there anything else?
All things must pass... until next time.
That's all you need.
You don't have enough money.
How much shall I temper it?
Wait a moment...
Hmm... how's this?
